name: Money Market Foreign Exchange Swaps Statistical Report V 02
definition: The MoneyMarketSecuredMarketStatisticalReport message is sent by the reporting agents to the relevant competent authority, to report all daily Foreign Exchange Swaps (FX Swaps) transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides the elements specific to the report.

ForeignExchangeSwapsReport.name: Foreign Exchange Swaps Report
ForeignExchangeSwapsReport.definition: Provides the reason why no activity is reported or the required list of transactions for the foreign exchange swaps segment.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
